This password screen keeps casual visitors out. It is NOT real login security — the code is stored in this file's source, so anyone who reads the file can find it. For real admin accounts, the store needs a backend with proper logins.

🛠️ Dashboard — Add Product

Products you add here are saved in this browser. Use “Publish to website” to bake them into the website files.

Your added products

Publish downloads TWO files: index.html (the customer website, updated) and dashboard.html (this panel, updated). Replace both files on your hosting with the downloaded copies, then push to GitHub. If your browser asks about multiple downloads, allow it.

Published products become part of the website permanently and can no longer be deleted from here — only products added after the last Publish can be deleted.
